description: React component for managing and displaying installed incoming webhooks in Mattermost, including pagination, filtering, and rendering webhook items.

classes.name: InstalledIncomingWebhooks
classes.description: React component class for displaying and managing incoming webhooks.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes component state with page 0 and loading true.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Loads the first page of webhooks when component mounts.

methods.name: loadPage
methods.description: Loads a specific page of webhooks asynchronously.

methods.name: nextPage
methods.description: Loads the next page of webhooks.

methods.name: previousPage
methods.description: Loads the previous page of webhooks.

methods.name: incomingWebhookCompare
methods.description: Compares two webhooks for sorting based on display name or channel.

methods.name: incomingWebhooks
methods.description: Filters, sorts, and maps webhooks to React components based on a search filter.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the list of webhooks with pagination, search, and help text.
